english.title: Registration plate supplier applying while suspended
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being subject to a court order suspending your registration as a registration plate supplier for **(..SPECIFY PERIOD..), made a further application for registration within that period in contravention of that order
english.legislation: Contrary to section 19(5) and (6) of the Vehicles (Crime) Act 2001.
english.pointstoprove:

english.notes:
(i) Proceedings under this Section instituted by a person or body other than a local authority or a constable must have the permission of the Attorney General.
(ii) See section 20(2) for alternative/additional penalty
(iii) See section 31(1) for other interpretations of Part 2 of the Act.

other.penalty:
SUMMARY: A fine not exceeding level five on the standard scale.

NOTE:
Where a registered person is convicted of this offence the court may, instead of or in addition to imposing a fine, by order suspend his registration for any period of up to five years. (section 20(2)).

Time limit for prosecutions:
6 months

On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates’ court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
